protocol: Opened P2/P3 panel. MLP0 local or aligned-prefix write transplant; all recipient persistent state retained. Natural donor MLP1 write difference is the target. Four normmatched local random controls and direct donor MLP1 write oracle. Prefix eligibility requires equal token lengths/anchor indices and exactly one earlier token difference.
limitations: Finite conditional transfer, not unique causal mediation decomposition.
Local and prefix edits have different support and norm; not a budget-matched competition.
Other context routes remain recipient-native; low recovery does not establish independence.
Reused authored panel, no fresh validation or task accuracy claim.
Pooled vector scores are energy weighted; signed projection is not a variance-explained percentage.
